<h2>Build an Empty Decomposition Variant Result</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Internal helper that constructs the stable failed-variant result schema.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>.build_empty_decomposition_variant(
  route_id,
  repeat_id,
  fold_id,
  variant,
  status,
  error_message,
  warning_text = NA_character_,
  diagnostics = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="route_id">route_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Diagnostic route identifier.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="repeat_id">repeat_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Repeated-fold identifier.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="fold_id">fold_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Fold identifier.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="variant">variant</code></td>
<td>
<p>Model variant identifier.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="status">status</code></td>
<td>
<p>Failure status.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="error_message">error_message</code></td>
<td>
<p>Captured error message.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="warning_text">warning_text</code></td>
<td>
<p>Collapsed warning text.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="diagnostics">diagnostics</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional one-row fold diagnostics.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>One-row failed-variant tibble.
</p>
